text:
maya.k: Quick triage — I flipped contractor-joe from Editor -> Viewer in Console for project-psi (to test UI gating). Audit log record exists but payload missing 'kms_key_id' and 'key_alias'. See snippet below. Anyone seen this pattern?
sam.h: I saw something similar last week after the role-matrix refactor. Did you repro or is it intermittent?
maya.k: Intermittent. First attempt logged fine, second attempt (this one) has nulls.
arjun.r: Can you paste the raw audit line? Also which backend version?
deploy-bot: deploy completed: service-console v3.14.7 -> canary -> prod at 2026-03-18T22:45Z
maya.k: pasted raw:
```
{"event":"role_update","actor":"maya.k","target":"contractor-joe","from":"Editor","to":"Viewer","ts":"2026-03-18T23:01:39Z","audit":{"kms_key_id":null,"key_alias":null,"sig":"..."}}
```
arjun.r: Hmm, sig present but kms fields null. Could be event assembly changed; maybe the audit wrapper moved before KMS attach in the call chain.
security-oncall: Assigning to security triage. @arjun.r please collect correlation_id and proxy logs. Also check KMS request logs for that timespan.
sam.h: I can look at UI flow — maybe the toggle path uses a lighter RPC that doesn't include encryption metadata.
maya.k: Correlation id: cid-0a9f2b. I grabbed browser console network trace and backend request id req-5221.
kms-audit-bot: KMS audit: No failed decrypts around req-5221. Last key rotation for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234:key/abcd was 2026-03-17T05:12:00Z. No errors.
arjun.r: Plan: 1) Fetch server logs for req-5221, 2) confirm event assembly order, 3) add temporary guard to populate kms metadata before audit write. I'll post updates.
maya.k: Thanks. Also flagging this for compliance — if audit logs sometimes omit KMS context we need a retroactive scan. @security-oncall
security-oncall: Agreed. Please add a daily job to scan role_update events in the last 7 days for missing kms_key_id. If count > 0 we escalate. I'll open an incident if >5.
sam.h: I'll open a PR to ensure event payload is enriched centrally. Short-term patch will add fallback to include key alias from request headers.
arjun.r: Noted. Will start log pull now, will report by EOD.
maya.k: :thumbsup: thanks.
